attempts.summary: Configured node1 with a boot-enabled, chrooted web application on TCP/8080. It runs as locked, non-login account appsvc with zero capabilities, read-only application files, and SELinux enforcing. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 were preserved. A mandatory safe restart changed the boot ID, after which the service, data, firewall rule, SSH access, and confinement recovered successfully.
